analogy.rationale: GUCY1A2/A3 and GUCY1B3 encode the soluble guanylyl cyclase subunits that are the direct target of this class, but these are largely restricted to vascular smooth muscle and platelets, so most of the nine cell lines should show little transcriptional response. The closest reference classes are those acting on the same cGMP/NO axis (guanylate cyclase activator, nitric oxide synthase inhibitor) or on cyclic nucleotide signaling more broadly.
